title: Top 5 Most DANGEROUS Planets In The Universe
hook: Number one rains molten glass sideways at 5,400 mph.

items.name: Venus
items.stat: Surface heat of 465°C and clouds of sulfuric acid crush and melt everything.

items.name: Mars
items.stat: Planet-wide dust storms can rage for months and blanket the entire globe.

items.name: Jupiter
items.stat: Its radiation belts blast 25 million volts and would kill a human in hours.

items.name: WASP-12b
items.stat: This doomed gas giant is being devoured by its star at 2,600°C.

items.name: HD 189733b
items.stat: Winds of 5,400 mph hurl molten glass rain sideways across the sky.
